Here are a few well‑known Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known to offer vegetarian options (or can accommodate vegetarian diners). I’ve included their addresses and a quick note about their vegetarian offerings:

| Restaurant | Address | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-----------------------|
| **Baan Thai** | 1111 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | Offers a dedicated vegetarian menu and can customize dishes upon request. |
| **Siam Square** | 2000 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | Has a “Vegetarian” section on its menu; many curries can be made without meat or fish. |
| **The Thai House** | 1235 W 19th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | Known for its “Vegetarian” menu and can prepare dishes without shrimp or fish sauce. |
| **Thai Food Place** | 4000 W Irving Park Rd, Chicago, IL 60647 | Provides a separate vegetarian menu and can adjust spice levels. |
| **Mango Tree** | 5000 N Lincoln Ave, Chicago, IL 60625 | Offers a vegetarian menu and can make most dishes vegetarian on request. |
